rules.penalty: Warning on first offense; $300 per day for 2nd and subsequent offenses.
rules.quote: The Housing Stability Notification Act requires ANY LANDLORDS planning to end a tenancy agreement to provide the tenant with a Notice of Tenants' Rights and Resources.
relations_hint: If a landlord violates the act, it DOES NOT halt the eviction process.
rules.requirement: Any landlord planning to end a tenancy agreement must provide the tenant with a Notice of Tenants' Rights and Resources at the same time as the Notice to Quit or Notice of non-renewal of lease.
rules.title: Notice of Tenant Rights and Resources Requirement

rules.penalty: Fine up to $300 per day for failure to submit.
rules.quote: Landlords must use this online form to provide tenant contact information and upload a copy of the Notice to Quit or Notice of Non-renewal of Lease.
rules.requirement: Landlords and foreclosing owners must complete and submit a Notice to Quit/Non-renewal of Lease Submission Verification Form through an online portal, providing tenant contact information and a copy of the notice.
rules.title: Notice to Quit/Non-renewal Submission Requirement
